# awscc_securityagent_artifact (Resource)

Uploads an artifact to an agent space. Artifacts provide additional context for security testing, such as architecture diagrams, API specifications, or configuration files.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the agent space to add the artifact to.
- `artifact_type` (String) The file type of the artifact.
- `file_name` (String) The file name of the artifact.

### Optional

- `artifact_content` (String) The binary content of the artifact to upload, encoded as a Base64 string.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the artifact.
- `artifact_id` (String) The unique identifier assigned to the uploaded artifact.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the artifact was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_securityagent_artifact.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the artifact

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_securityagent_artifact.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_securityagent_artifact.example "arn"
```
